يبتدهوا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَدِهُوا (yabtadihū) /jab.ta.di.huː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# يُبْتَدَهُوا (yubtadahū) /jub.ta.da.huː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
